description: Lázeňská péče – charakteristika pacientů s hrazenou péčí is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo zdravotnictví. The data set provides basic information about patients receiving spa therapeutic rehabilitation care in the Czech Republic since 2015 covered by public health insurance, both comprehensive and contributory. Coverage: Ministerstvo zdravotnictví. The portal shows the English title as "Spa treatment – characteristics of patients with paid care" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo zdravotnictví. Its keywords include NRHZS, spa treatment, patient, lázeňská péče, NRRHS, pacient. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00024341/1f43e925279ada069c036a1f0f95478d/distribuce/a857979201e7b34660cec4fe23de16dd/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
